decisions.reason: As a specialist naval lighting system that still remained on the website through 2024, it fits the firm's demanding-environment portfolio and is worth keeping open because project-cycle uncertainty is still plausible while incremental carrying costs are likely modest for a large firm.

This general interior luminaire looks less strategically distinctive than the firm's smarter and more application-specific offers, but its continued 2024 presence suggests the option has not failed clearly enough yet to justify withdrawal.

Because D was still highlighted in 2024 as a latest release and presented as a flagship direction, management would be very likely to keep backing it as a core option aligned with the firm's intelligent, design-led lighting strategy.

The marine searchlight remains consistent with the firm's robust specialist-lighting capabilities and, absent clear negative signals, a large incumbent would typically retain such a niche product while its market value continues to resolve.
